  • Class
    Description
    AIConfig
    An app's AI configuration, loaded and validated by AIConfigLoader: the gateways of its parent (global) file, the models the app uses with their merged settings, and the app's roots, named pools of entry models.
    AIConfigException
    A config file that is missing, unreadable or breaks a rule.
    AIConfigLoader
    Loads an app's AI configuration: its app file and the global file the app file names as its parent.
    FallbackInfo
    Where a job goes after a model fails it for good: an ordered list of models per failure kind, and a default list for the kinds without one.
    GatewayInfo
    A gateway as the global config defines it: where models are hosted and what the provider enforces.
    GatewayType
    The transports a gateway can use, by their type in the config.
    ModelInfo
    A model as an app uses it: the global definition (where it is hosted, the provider's limits) merged with the app's policy for it.
    RateLimit
    Requests allowed per minute and per UTC day (reset at 00:00 UTC); 0 means no limit.
